changes.name: Postman（ブログ）
changes.diff_text:
-Postman Passport: Secure API access for the Agentic Era
-Abhinav Asthana
-Postman Passport gives agents and developers credential references instead of real API keys, keeping secrets inside your VPC and eliminating secret sprawl.
+AI-Ready APIs: Agents Are the New Audience
+Austin Rowland
+Learn how AI agents evaluate and choose APIs differently than developers, and how to make your API ready for the agents that will consume it.
+Announcing the Postman Accredited Seller: our first global partner sales accreditation
+Doug Lavanchy
+APIs are no longer background plumbing. As API conversations move from developer tooling to board-level strategy and agentic initiatives, partners need more…
+Read more →
+MCP goes stateless — and Postman’s ready
+ruben.casas
+See how Postman’s MCP Inspector supports the 2026-07-28 MCP spec, including stateless transport, so you can test and debug servers before migration.
+Read more →
-How DevRel saves thousands of tokens per Claude Code run
-Quinton Wall
-A benchmark report: we audited 19 production Claude Code skills, cut invocation costs 23% (13,300 tokens per run), and found none had tool scoping. Here’s the data — and what it’s worth in dollars.
-Read more →
-Share your local API changes for review—before they reach the Cloud
-Ajay Yadav
-Postman draft workspaces let you share a live preview URL of your local Native Git work before merging. Learn how the review-before-publish workflow works.
-Read more →
changes.summary: Postmanブログにて、AIエージェント向けのAPI最適化や、最新のMCP仕様に対応した「MCP Inspector」の紹介記事が公開されました。さらに、初のグローバルパートナー向け販売認定制度「Postman Accredited Seller」についても発表されています。
